speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is very well penned, Master Shakespeare. I had not thought to be made to pity him; I shall remember that it can be done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That what can be done? That a man can be made to pity a king put down. Or that a king can be put down. The same four words.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Very well penned. He looked at the hand, not the face. They all know me by the hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it as praise. Say it as a warning. Say it as a secretary's habit of saying nothing in a full sentence. All three fit in the mouth. None of them is a verdict.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two nights since I had forty candles and the Queen's own councillor, and I'm lying here construing him like Ovid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He saw the three leaves. Hunsdon's daughter saw them. The Master cut them. All three are content. Nobody is ever told what the others know.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Yesterday the lovers played a second time, to a house nearly as full, and I said the Prologue with a steady heart.
